war_summary: War 139 is on day 122 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required), and the map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the prior snapshot (~3h ago), Endless Shore remains the largest battle: 8-1-1 Colonial now, 43 events/24h with an event at cutoff, and casualty rates have re-accelerated sharply (~375-415/hr per side over 2h windows) after a cooling phase. Clahstra continues escalating dramatically — casualty rates have roughly doubled again (~1130-1340/hr per side over 2h) with heavy fighting around Transept (9 events/24h), Bewailing Fort and East Narthex; the split has tightened to 5-3 Warden. Callahan's Passage shows massive sustained losses (~700/hr per side over 2h, ~9k/24h each side) with fresh events at Overlook Hill, Scáth Passing and Solas Gora minutes ago, now split 5-5. Speaking Woods is surging hard (~1050-1070/hr per side over 2h, ~1300 enlistments/24h, events at Stem minutes before cutoff, 6-1-1 Warden-leaning). Onyx has reignited with very heavy casualties (~1280-1300/hr over 2h) and recent activity at The Waif, still split 3-3. Marban Hollow remains intense (~850-1190/hr per side over 2h, ~2050 enlistments/24h) though its latest event is ~11h old, 5-3 Warden. Mooring County is newly active with 6 events/24h at Borderlane and Luch's Workshop, latest event ~20min before cutoff, 11-1 Colonial but accelerating warden casualties. Godcrofts cooled after its knife-fight (26 events/24h at Saegio/Argosa, latest ~3h old, 6-3 Colonial); Oarbreaker and StemaLanding show no events in the last several hours despite earlier surges. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
